_comment: Chapter 03's calls, in the same schema as calls.json, kept in their own file so chapters written in parallel don't collide. Each call names the least-privileged Microsoft Graph permission from its Learn page, read on October 30, 2026. The migration matrix is offline logic over Chapter 01's register and Chapter 02's ownership run; its only network calls are two reads. tests/NpiMatrix.Tests.ps1 fails when the task's declaration isn't exactly the union of its calls, or when it declares anything but GET.

calls.note: Reads the SPN owner named for each account kept on Kerberos and the rollback owner named for each wave, with $select=id,userPrincipalName,userType,accountEnabled, so only an enabled member counts (Chapter 02's rule).

Reads whether the tenant holds a Workload ID Premium subscription (service plans AAD_WRKLDID_P1 or AAD_WRKLDID_P2) and how many units are enabled, for the D-N4 scope. Supports $select only, not $filter.
